unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 8 - Write My Speech - Year 5-6 Literacy.pptx
anchor: Claim it. Prove it. Sell it. Say it. The writing anchor plus a microphone (say it), and the speech rule: write for the ear. Final piece: a rehearsed persuasive speech delivered to a live audience.

lessons.title: What Do I Stand For?
lessons.focus: Choose an issue, position, audience and think-feel-do purpose for the speech. Critical feature: an audience you can picture tells you what to say.

lessons.title: Gather the Proof
lessons.focus: Collect evidence and order three arguments, saving the strongest for last. Critical feature: the order of arguments builds the audience's feeling.

lessons.title: Write the Opening
lessons.focus: Draft the speech opening and first argument for the ear. Critical feature: the first 20 seconds decide whether they listen.

lessons.title: The Heart of the Speech
lessons.focus: Draft the middle arguments and one emotional moment: a story or picture. Critical feature: one true small story beats ten big claims.

lessons.title: The Big Finish
lessons.focus: Draft the conclusion and call to action, time the speech and make cue cards. Critical feature: cue cards hold key words, not sentences.
